belugawales3: Day 9: Albin Belugawales reached S-C3 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

The Hegemony sentry, Casimir Schradog, shouted once. Albin Belugawales silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@schradog2) Albin Belugawales was on watch at S-C3 when the night raid hit. The men found Albin Belugawales at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Casimir Schradog of the Hegemony (@schradog2).
Gustav Belugawales joined S-C3 under the shadow of Albin Belugawales's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
billy.forestier: The old hands of T-F20 have been here since Day 1. Edmund Forestier has been here since Day 10. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
dunkmyanactual: Otto Dunkmyanactu arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

An enemy patrol scattered in front of S-R4. Otto Dunkmyanactu fired at the last man to run. Karel Lynallwarrio was grazed. A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-R4 and grazed Otto Dunkmyanactu's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Emil Majormalprac of the Concord (@majormalpractice_626). News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Otto Dunkmyanactu during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better. A letter from home reached Otto Dunkmyanactu before dusk. Otto Dunkmyanactu read it twice and slept a little easier.
edheadl: Lucien Edheadl came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Lucien Edheadl did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again. A letter from home reached Lucien Edheadl before dusk. Lucien Edheadl read it twice and slept a little easier. Lucien Edheadl bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.'
jacob.hendryx: They issued Emil Hendryx a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a stub of a pencil in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached T-F8 with the rations. Emil Hendryx ate while listening to the revised orders.
jirka_knoppu: Lucien Knoppu walked into Q-S9 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached Q-S9 with the rations. Lucien Knoppu ate while listening to the revised orders.
monty.mace: Cyril Mace arrived on Day 10 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
mr._tax_evader: Cyril "Spark" Evader walked into T-F22 on Day 10 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
sem0235: Albin Sem came up with a draft of replacements on Day 5. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

Albin Sem shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Sem. Albin Sem read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Victory at Hill 304. Albin Sem let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Albin Sem began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Sem. Albin Sem read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Orders came through: Albin Sem is a rifleman now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts.

Albin Sem sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Sem. Albin Sem read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Felix Jakub and Albin Sem split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Sem. Albin Sem read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Gustav Karter taught Albin Sem three words in the language of home. Albin uses all three at the wrong moment, every day. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Sem. Albin Sem read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

In the dark of the Concord trench Albin Sem hit Yann Vee with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@ask._.vee) The Concord sentry, Tobias Noirangelfan, shouted once. Albin Sem silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@noirangelfang) Albin Sem came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. Albin Sem ate a whole bowl of soup today. The surgeon says that is better than any medicine. Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Albin Sem shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Sem. Albin Sem read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
tezands: In Wyvern Cross, Isidor "Ash" Tezands was a shepherd. In S-S8, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a shepherd again. Isidor "Ash" Tezands transferred to the snipers. The men in S-S8 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.
Walter Small of the Hegemony threw a tin of tobacco into the Concord trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Isidor "Ash" Tezands kept the tin.
Isidor "Ash" Tezands wrote a letter for Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas's mother, because Mole could not find the words. Mole signed it.
After the shelling at S-S8, nobody could account for Isidor "Ash" Tezands. His kit remains beside the bunk.
The squad at S-S8 still leaves a gap on the fire step where Isidor "Ash" Tezands used to stand.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Isidor "Ash" Tezands wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
thicc_kochek: The quartermaster asked Bram Kochek to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Bram Kochek helped stack spare sandbags at S-R8. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
tonyhuang000: Florian Tonyhuang was a ferryman in Coldwater until the posters went up. He came to S-F6 with a tin of tobacco, and within a day the whole bay knew that he can fall asleep anywhere, instantly.
Verdel Ridge is lost. Florian Tonyhuang heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Florian Tonyhuang began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.

The barrage caught Florian Tonyhuang in the open at S-F6. The medic tied two tourniquets and shouted for a bed. An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Florian Tonyhuang was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout. Florian Tonyhuang slipped away in the night. The orderly who sat with him says he was not afraid.
Zeno Tonyhuang came to the front because his father Florian Tonyhuang never came home. He carries a tin of tobacco.

A rat stole Zeno Tonyhuang's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier. News that the Hegemony had taken Hill 304 reached Zeno Tonyhuang during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Zeno Tonyhuang offered a length of string for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity.
Dawn watch. Zeno Tonyhuang put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar, grazed.
A parcel came for Zeno Tonyhuang that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: several carefully wrapped biscuits. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.

Zeno Tonyhuang felt a hard tug at his hip at S-F6. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar of the Concord (@corporalstars).

The wound on Zeno Tonyhuang's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter. The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Zeno Tonyhuang helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
